"""Download MERaLiON-OmniVoice-Hokkien-TTS model weights from Hugging Face.

The repo (~2.7 GB) contains the fine-tuned LLM weights (model.safetensors)
plus a bundled HiGGS Audio v2 tokenizer (audio_tokenizer/). This script
fetches the full snapshot into a local directory so it can be loaded offline
by scripts/serve_meralion_tts.py.

The model is gated under the MERaLiON-3 Public Licence — accept the licence
on the model page and pass a Hugging Face token (or set HF_TOKEN) if you hit
a 401/403 error.

Usage::

    uv run scripts/download_meralion_tts.py
    uv run scripts/download_meralion_tts.py --output-dir models/MERaLiON-OmniVoice-Hokkien-TTS --token hf_xxx
"""

import argparse
import os
import sys
from pathlib import Path

_PROJECT_ROOT = Path(__file__).resolve().parents[1]
DEFAULT_REPO_ID = "MERaLiON/MERaLiON-OmniVoice-Hokkien-TTS"
DEFAULT_OUTPUT_DIR = _PROJECT_ROOT / "models" / "MERaLiON-OmniVoice-Hokkien-TTS"


def _parse_args() -> argparse.Namespace:
    parser = argparse.ArgumentParser(description=__doc__)
    parser.add_argument("--repo-id", default=DEFAULT_REPO_ID, help="Hugging Face repo id to download.")
    parser.add_argument(
        "--output-dir",
        type=Path,
        default=DEFAULT_OUTPUT_DIR,
        help="Local directory to store the model snapshot.",
    )
    parser.add_argument("--revision", default="main", help="Git revision/branch/tag to download.")
    parser.add_argument(
        "--token",
        default=os.getenv("HF_TOKEN") or os.getenv("HUGGINGFACE_HUB_TOKEN"),
        help="Hugging Face access token (defaults to HF_TOKEN/HUGGINGFACE_HUB_TOKEN env vars).",
    )
    parser.add_argument(
        "--force",
        action="store_true",
        help="Re-download files even if they already exist in the local cache.",
    )
    return parser.parse_args()


def _dir_size_bytes(path: Path) -> int:
    return sum(f.stat().st_size for f in path.rglob("*") if f.is_file())


def main() -> None:
    args = _parse_args()

    try:
        from huggingface_hub import snapshot_download
        from huggingface_hub.errors import GatedRepoError, RepositoryNotFoundError
    except ImportError:
        sys.exit("huggingface_hub is required. Install project dependencies first: uv sync")

    args.output_dir.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)

    print(f"Downloading {args.repo_id} (revision={args.revision}) -> {args.output_dir}")
    print("This is ~2.7 GB total; it may take a while on first run.")

    try:
        snapshot_download(
            repo_id=args.repo_id,
            revision=args.revision,
            local_dir=str(args.output_dir),
            token=args.token,
            force_download=args.force,
            # Skip repo docs/assets we don't need for inference.
            allow_patterns=["*.json", "*.safetensors", "*.jinja", "*.txt", "audio_tokenizer/**"],
        )
    except GatedRepoError:
        sys.exit(
            f"Access denied for gated repo '{args.repo_id}'.\n"
            "1. Visit https://huggingface.co/{} and accept the MERaLiON-3 Public Licence.\n"
            "2. Create an access token at https://huggingface.co/settings/tokens\n"
            "3. Re-run with --token <your_token> or set HF_TOKEN in your environment.".format(
                args.repo_id
            )
        )
    except RepositoryNotFoundError:
        sys.exit(f"Repo '{args.repo_id}' not found. Check --repo-id and your token permissions.")

    total_bytes = _dir_size_bytes(args.output_dir)
    print(f"✅ Download complete: {args.output_dir} ({total_bytes / 1e9:.2f} GB)")
    print(
        "Next: serve the model with\n"
        f"  uv run scripts/serve_meralion_tts.py --model-dir {args.output_dir}"
    )


if __name__ == "__main__":
    main()

"""HTTP server for MERaLiON-OmniVoice-Hokkien-TTS.

There is no official inference server for OmniVoice-based models (only a
Python API and a Gradio demo), so this wraps the `omnivoice` library in a
small FastAPI service that returns synthesized WAV audio over HTTP — the
same shape Pipecat TTS services expect from a local server (c.f. Piper).

Download the weights first::

    uv run scripts/download_meralion_tts.py

Then run the server::

    uv run scripts/serve_meralion_tts.py --model-dir models/MERaLiON-OmniVoice-Hokkien-TTS

Optionally pin a default voice by providing a reference clip at startup, so
requests that omit `ref_audio` still get a consistent voice::

    uv run scripts/serve_meralion_tts.py \\
        --model-dir models/MERaLiON-OmniVoice-Hokkien-TTS \\
        --default-ref-audio assets/reference_speaker.wav \\
        --default-ref-text "Reference transcript in Hokkien"

API::

    GET  /health
    POST /v1/audio/speech
        form fields: text (required), language ("nan" default), ref_text,
                     instruct, speed, num_step
        file field:  ref_audio (optional; triggers one-off voice cloning)
        -> audio/wav bytes
"""

import argparse
import io
import os
import tempfile
from contextlib import asynccontextmanager
from pathlib import Path
from typing import Optional

from dotenv import load_dotenv
from fastapi import FastAPI, Form, HTTPException, Request, UploadFile
from fastapi.responses import Response
from loguru import logger

_PROJECT_ROOT = Path(__file__).resolve().parents[1]
load_dotenv(dotenv_path=_PROJECT_ROOT / ".env", override=True)

DEFAULT_MODEL_DIR = _PROJECT_ROOT / "models" / "MERaLiON-OmniVoice-Hokkien-TTS"

_DTYPE_NAMES = {"float16", "float32", "bfloat16"}


class ModelState:
    """Holds the loaded model and a lock so requests are serialized on one GPU."""

    def __init__(self):
        self.model = None
        self.lock = None
        self.default_voice_prompt = None
        self.default_instruct: Optional[str] = None


state = ModelState()


def _resolve_device(requested: str) -> str:
    import torch

    if requested != "auto":
        return requested
    if torch.cuda.is_available():
        return "cuda:0"
    if getattr(torch.backends, "mps", None) and torch.backends.mps.is_available():
        return "mps"
    return "cpu"


def _resolve_dtype(name: str, device: str):
    import torch

    if device == "cpu" and name == "float16":
        logger.warning("float16 is not well supported on CPU; using float32 instead")
        name = "float32"
    return {"float16": torch.float16, "float32": torch.float32, "bfloat16": torch.bfloat16}[name]


def _load_model(model_dir: str, device: str, dtype_name: str):
    import asyncio

    from omnivoice import OmniVoice

    resolved_device = _resolve_device(device)
    dtype = _resolve_dtype(dtype_name, resolved_device)

    logger.info("Loading MERaLiON-OmniVoice-Hokkien-TTS from {} (device={})", model_dir, resolved_device)
    model = OmniVoice.from_pretrained(model_dir, device_map=resolved_device, dtype=dtype)
    logger.info("✅ Model loaded (sampling_rate={})", model.sampling_rate)

    state.model = model
    state.lock = asyncio.Lock()


@asynccontextmanager
async def lifespan(app: FastAPI):
    args = app.state.cli_args
    _load_model(args.model_dir, args.device, args.dtype)

    if args.default_ref_audio:
        logger.info("Building default voice-clone prompt from {}", args.default_ref_audio)
        state.default_voice_prompt = state.model.create_voice_clone_prompt(
            ref_audio=args.default_ref_audio,
            ref_text=args.default_ref_text,
        )
    elif args.default_instruct:
        state.default_instruct = args.default_instruct

    yield

    state.model = None


app = FastAPI(title="MERaLiON-OmniVoice-Hokkien-TTS server", lifespan=lifespan)


def _check_api_key(request: Request) -> None:
    api_key = request.app.state.cli_args.api_key
    if not api_key:
        return
    header = request.headers.get("authorization", "")
    token = header.removeprefix("Bearer ").strip()
    if token != api_key:
        raise HTTPException(status_code=401, detail="Invalid or missing API key")


@app.get("/health")
async def health():
    return {
        "status": "ok" if state.model is not None else "loading",
        "sampling_rate": getattr(state.model, "sampling_rate", None),
    }


@app.post("/v1/audio/speech")
async def synthesize(
    request: Request,
    text: str = Form(...),
    language: str = Form("nan"),
    ref_text: Optional[str] = Form(None),
    instruct: Optional[str] = Form(None),
    speed: float = Form(1.0),
    num_step: int = Form(32),
    ref_audio: Optional[UploadFile] = None,
):
    _check_api_key(request)

    if state.model is None:
        raise HTTPException(status_code=503, detail="Model is still loading")

    if not text.strip():
        raise HTTPException(status_code=400, detail="`text` must not be empty")

    generate_kwargs = {
        "text": text,
        "language": language,
        "speed": speed,
        "num_step": num_step,
    }

    tmp_ref_path: Optional[str] = None
    try:
        if ref_audio is not None:
            suffix = Path(ref_audio.filename or "ref.wav").suffix or ".wav"
            with tempfile.NamedTemporaryFile(suffix=suffix, delete=False) as tmp:
                tmp.write(await ref_audio.read())
                tmp_ref_path = tmp.name
            generate_kwargs["ref_audio"] = tmp_ref_path
            if ref_text:
                generate_kwargs["ref_text"] = ref_text
        elif instruct:
            generate_kwargs["instruct"] = instruct
        elif state.default_voice_prompt is not None:
            generate_kwargs["voice_clone_prompt"] = state.default_voice_prompt
        elif state.default_instruct:
            generate_kwargs["instruct"] = state.default_instruct

        async with state.lock:
            import asyncio

            audios = await asyncio.to_thread(state.model.generate, **generate_kwargs)
    except Exception as exc:  # noqa: BLE001 - surface inference errors to the client
        logger.exception("TTS generation failed")
        raise HTTPException(status_code=500, detail=str(exc)) from exc
    finally:
        if tmp_ref_path is not None:
            os.unlink(tmp_ref_path)

    import soundfile as sf

    buffer = io.BytesIO()
    sf.write(buffer, audios[0], state.model.sampling_rate, format="WAV")
    return Response(content=buffer.getvalue(), media_type="audio/wav")


def _parse_args() -> argparse.Namespace:
    parser = argparse.ArgumentParser(description=__doc__)
    parser.add_argument("--model-dir", default=str(DEFAULT_MODEL_DIR), help="Local model dir or HF repo id.")
    parser.add_argument("--host", default=os.getenv("MERALION_TTS_HOST", "127.0.0.1"))
    parser.add_argument("--port", type=int, default=int(os.getenv("MERALION_TTS_PORT", "8090")))
    parser.add_argument(
        "--device",
        default=os.getenv("MERALION_TTS_DEVICE", "auto"),
        help="'auto', 'cuda:0', 'mps', or 'cpu'.",
    )
    parser.add_argument(
        "--dtype",
        default=os.getenv("MERALION_TTS_DTYPE", "float16"),
        choices=sorted(_DTYPE_NAMES),
    )
    parser.add_argument(
        "--default-ref-audio",
        default=os.getenv("MERALION_TTS_DEFAULT_REF_AUDIO"),
        help="Reference clip (3-8s) used to pin a default cloned voice for all requests.",
    )
    parser.add_argument(
        "--default-ref-text",
        default=os.getenv("MERALION_TTS_DEFAULT_REF_TEXT"),
        help="Transcript matching --default-ref-audio.",
    )
    parser.add_argument(
        "--default-instruct",
        default=os.getenv("MERALION_TTS_DEFAULT_INSTRUCT"),
        help="Voice-design attributes (e.g. 'female, low pitch') used when no ref audio is set.",
    )
    parser.add_argument(
        "--api-key",
        default=os.getenv("MERALION_TTS_API_KEY"),
        help="If set, requests must send 'Authorization: Bearer <key>'.",
    )
    return parser.parse_args()


def main() -> None:
    import uvicorn

    args = _parse_args()

    if args.default_ref_audio and not args.default_ref_text:
        raise SystemExit("--default-ref-text is required when --default-ref-audio is set")

    app.state.cli_args = args
    uvicorn.run(app, host=args.host, port=args.port)


if __name__ == "__main__":
    main()

#

"""Download MERaLiON-OmniVoice-Hokkien-TTS model weights from Hugging Face.

The repo (~2.7 GB) contains the fine-tuned LLM weights (model.safetensors)
plus a bundled HiGGS Audio v2 tokenizer (audio_tokenizer/). This script
fetches the full snapshot into a local directory so it can be loaded offline
by scripts/serve_meralion_tts.py.

The model is gated under the MERaLiON-3 Public Licence — accept the licence
on the model page and pass a Hugging Face token (or set HF_TOKEN) if you hit
a 401/403 error.

Usage::

    uv run scripts/download_meralion_tts.py
    uv run scripts/download_meralion_tts.py --output-dir models/MERaLiON-OmniVoice-Hokkien-TTS --token hf_xxx
"""

import argparse
import os
import sys
from pathlib import Path

_PROJECT_ROOT = Path(__file__).resolve().parents[1]
DEFAULT_REPO_ID = "MERaLiON/MERaLiON-OmniVoice-Hokkien-TTS"
DEFAULT_OUTPUT_DIR = _PROJECT_ROOT / "models" / "MERaLiON-OmniVoice-Hokkien-TTS"


def _parse_args() -> argparse.Namespace:
    parser = argparse.ArgumentParser(description=__doc__)
    parser.add_argument("--repo-id", default=DEFAULT_REPO_ID, help="Hugging Face repo id to download.")
    parser.add_argument(
        "--output-dir",
        type=Path,
        default=DEFAULT_OUTPUT_DIR,
        help="Local directory to store the model snapshot.",
    )
    parser.add_argument("--revision", default="main", help="Git revision/branch/tag to download.")
    parser.add_argument(
        "--token",
        default=os.getenv("HF_TOKEN") or os.getenv("HUGGINGFACE_HUB_TOKEN"),
        help="Hugging Face access token (defaults to HF_TOKEN/HUGGINGFACE_HUB_TOKEN env vars).",
    )
    parser.add_argument(
        "--force",
        action="store_true",
        help="Re-download files even if they already exist in the local cache.",
    )
    return parser.parse_args()


def _dir_size_bytes(path: Path) -> int:
    return sum(f.stat().st_size for f in path.rglob("*") if f.is_file())


def main() -> None:
    args = _parse_args()

    try:
        from huggingface_hub import snapshot_download
        from huggingface_hub.errors import GatedRepoError, RepositoryNotFoundError
    except ImportError:
        sys.exit("huggingface_hub is required. Install project dependencies first: uv sync")

    args.output_dir.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)

    print(f"Downloading {args.repo_id} (revision={args.revision}) -> {args.output_dir}")
    print("This is ~2.7 GB total; it may take a while on first run.")

    try:
        snapshot_download(
            repo_id=args.repo_id,
            revision=args.revision,
            local_dir=str(args.output_dir),
            token=args.token,
            force_download=args.force,
            # Skip repo docs/assets we don't need for inference.
            allow_patterns=["*.json", "*.safetensors", "*.jinja", "*.txt", "audio_tokenizer/**"],
        )
    except GatedRepoError:
        sys.exit(
            f"Access denied for gated repo '{args.repo_id}'.\n"
            "1. Visit https://huggingface.co/{} and accept the MERaLiON-3 Public Licence.\n"
            "2. Create an access token at https://huggingface.co/settings/tokens\n"
            "3. Re-run with --token <your_token> or set HF_TOKEN in your environment.".format(
                args.repo_id
            )
        )
    except RepositoryNotFoundError:
        sys.exit(f"Repo '{args.repo_id}' not found. Check --repo-id and your token permissions.")

    total_bytes = _dir_size_bytes(args.output_dir)
    print(f"✅ Download complete: {args.output_dir} ({total_bytes / 1e9:.2f} GB)")
    print(
        "Next: serve the model with\n"
        f"  uv run scripts/serve_meralion_tts.py --model-dir {args.output_dir}"
    )


if __name__ == "__main__":
    main()

#

#
# SPDX-License-Identifier: BSD 2-Clause License
#

"""HTTP server for MERaLiON-OmniVoice-Hokkien-TTS.

There is no official inference server for OmniVoice-based models (only a
Python API and a Gradio demo), so this wraps the `omnivoice` library in a
small FastAPI service that returns synthesized WAV audio over HTTP — the
same shape Pipecat TTS services expect from a local server (c.f. Piper).

Download the weights first::

    uv run scripts/download_meralion_tts.py

Then run the server::

    uv run scripts/serve_meralion_tts.py --model-dir models/MERaLiON-OmniVoice-Hokkien-TTS

Optionally pin a default voice by providing a reference clip at startup, so
requests that omit `ref_audio` still get a consistent voice::

    uv run scripts/serve_meralion_tts.py \\
        --model-dir models/MERaLiON-OmniVoice-Hokkien-TTS \\
        --default-ref-audio assets/reference_speaker.wav \\
        --default-ref-text "Reference transcript in Hokkien"

API::

    GET  /health
    POST /v1/audio/speech
        form fields: text (required), language ("nan" default), ref_text,
                     instruct, speed, num_step
        file field:  ref_audio (optional; triggers one-off voice cloning)
        -> audio/wav bytes
"""

import argparse
import io
import os
import tempfile
from contextlib import asynccontextmanager
from pathlib import Path
from typing import Optional

from dotenv import load_dotenv
from fastapi import FastAPI, Form, HTTPException, Request, UploadFile
from fastapi.responses import Response
from loguru import logger

_PROJECT_ROOT = Path(__file__).resolve().parents[1]
load_dotenv(dotenv_path=_PROJECT_ROOT / ".env", override=True)

DEFAULT_MODEL_DIR = _PROJECT_ROOT / "models" / "MERaLiON-OmniVoice-Hokkien-TTS"

_DTYPE_NAMES = {"float16", "float32", "bfloat16"}


class ModelState:
    """Holds the loaded model and a lock so requests are serialized on one GPU."""

    def __init__(self):
        self.model = None
        self.lock = None
        self.default_voice_prompt = None
        self.default_instruct: Optional[str] = None


state = ModelState()


def _resolve_device(requested: str) -> str:
    import torch

    if requested != "auto":
        return requested
    if torch.cuda.is_available():
        return "cuda:0"
    if getattr(torch.backends, "mps", None) and torch.backends.mps.is_available():
        return "mps"
    return "cpu"


def _resolve_dtype(name: str, device: str):
    import torch

    if device == "cpu" and name == "float16":
        logger.warning("float16 is not well supported on CPU; using float32 instead")
        name = "float32"
    return {"float16": torch.float16, "float32": torch.float32, "bfloat16": torch.bfloat16}[name]


def _load_model(model_dir: str, device: str, dtype_name: str):
    import asyncio

    from omnivoice import OmniVoice

    resolved_device = _resolve_device(device)
    dtype = _resolve_dtype(dtype_name, resolved_device)

    logger.info("Loading MERaLiON-OmniVoice-Hokkien-TTS from {} (device={})", model_dir, resolved_device)
    model = OmniVoice.from_pretrained(model_dir, device_map=resolved_device, dtype=dtype)
    logger.info("✅ Model loaded (sampling_rate={})", model.sampling_rate)

    state.model = model
    state.lock = asyncio.Lock()


@asynccontextmanager
async def lifespan(app: FastAPI):
    args = app.state.cli_args
    _load_model(args.model_dir, args.device, args.dtype)

    if args.default_ref_audio:
        logger.info("Building default voice-clone prompt from {}", args.default_ref_audio)
        state.default_voice_prompt = state.model.create_voice_clone_prompt(
            ref_audio=args.default_ref_audio,
            ref_text=args.default_ref_text,
        )
    elif args.default_instruct:
        state.default_instruct = args.default_instruct

    yield

    state.model = None


app = FastAPI(title="MERaLiON-OmniVoice-Hokkien-TTS server", lifespan=lifespan)


def _check_api_key(request: Request) -> None:
    api_key = request.app.state.cli_args.api_key
    if not api_key:
        return
    header = request.headers.get("authorization", "")
    token = header.removeprefix("Bearer ").strip()
    if token != api_key:
        raise HTTPException(status_code=401, detail="Invalid or missing API key")


@app.get("/health")
async def health():
    return {
        "status": "ok" if state.model is not None else "loading",
        "sampling_rate": getattr(state.model, "sampling_rate", None),
    }


@app.post("/v1/audio/speech")
async def synthesize(
    request: Request,
    text: str = Form(...),
    language: str = Form("nan"),
    ref_text: Optional[str] = Form(None),
    instruct: Optional[str] = Form(None),
    speed: float = Form(1.0),
    num_step: int = Form(32),
    ref_audio: Optional[UploadFile] = None,
):
    _check_api_key(request)

    if state.model is None:
        raise HTTPException(status_code=503, detail="Model is still loading")

    if not text.strip():
        raise HTTPException(status_code=400, detail="`text` must not be empty")

    generate_kwargs = {
        "text": text,
        "language": language,
        "speed": speed,
        "num_step": num_step,
    }

    tmp_ref_path: Optional[str] = None
    try:
        if ref_audio is not None:
            suffix = Path(ref_audio.filename or "ref.wav").suffix or ".wav"
            with tempfile.NamedTemporaryFile(suffix=suffix, delete=False) as tmp:
                tmp.write(await ref_audio.read())
                tmp_ref_path = tmp.name
            generate_kwargs["ref_audio"] = tmp_ref_path
            if ref_text:
                generate_kwargs["ref_text"] = ref_text
        elif instruct:
            generate_kwargs["instruct"] = instruct
        elif state.default_voice_prompt is not None:
            generate_kwargs["voice_clone_prompt"] = state.default_voice_prompt
        elif state.default_instruct:
            generate_kwargs["instruct"] = state.default_instruct

        async with state.lock:
            import asyncio

            audios = await asyncio.to_thread(state.model.generate, **generate_kwargs)
    except Exception as exc:  # noqa: BLE001 - surface inference errors to the client
        logger.exception("TTS generation failed")
        raise HTTPException(status_code=500, detail=str(exc)) from exc
    finally:
        if tmp_ref_path is not None:
            os.unlink(tmp_ref_path)

    import soundfile as sf

    buffer = io.BytesIO()
    sf.write(buffer, audios[0], state.model.sampling_rate, format="WAV")
    return Response(content=buffer.getvalue(), media_type="audio/wav")


def _parse_args() -> argparse.Namespace:
    parser = argparse.ArgumentParser(description=__doc__)
    parser.add_argument("--model-dir", default=str(DEFAULT_MODEL_DIR), help="Local model dir or HF repo id.")
    parser.add_argument("--host", default=os.getenv("MERALION_TTS_HOST", "127.0.0.1"))
    parser.add_argument("--port", type=int, default=int(os.getenv("MERALION_TTS_PORT", "8090")))
    parser.add_argument(
        "--device",
        default=os.getenv("MERALION_TTS_DEVICE", "auto"),
        help="'auto', 'cuda:0', 'mps', or 'cpu'.",
    )
    parser.add_argument(
        "--dtype",
        default=os.getenv("MERALION_TTS_DTYPE", "float16"),
        choices=sorted(_DTYPE_NAMES),
    )
    parser.add_argument(
        "--default-ref-audio",
        default=os.getenv("MERALION_TTS_DEFAULT_REF_AUDIO"),
        help="Reference clip (3-8s) used to pin a default cloned voice for all requests.",
    )
    parser.add_argument(
        "--default-ref-text",
        default=os.getenv("MERALION_TTS_DEFAULT_REF_TEXT"),
        help="Transcript matching --default-ref-audio.",
    )
    parser.add_argument(
        "--default-instruct",
        default=os.getenv("MERALION_TTS_DEFAULT_INSTRUCT"),
        help="Voice-design attributes (e.g. 'female, low pitch') used when no ref audio is set.",
    )
    parser.add_argument(
        "--api-key",
        default=os.getenv("MERALION_TTS_API_KEY"),
        help="If set, requests must send 'Authorization: Bearer <key>'.",
    )
    return parser.parse_args()


def main() -> None:
    import uvicorn

    args = _parse_args()

    if args.default_ref_audio and not args.default_ref_text:
        raise SystemExit("--default-ref-text is required when --default-ref-audio is set")

    app.state.cli_args = args
    uvicorn.run(app, host=args.host, port=args.port)


if __name__ == "__main__":
    main()

#

"""Pipecat Quickstart — Voice bot.

Required AI services:
 - MERaLiON speech translation API (Hokkien audio → English text)
 - llama.cpp server (LLM) — served via OpenAI-compatible HTTP API
 - Piper (Text-to-Speech)

Run the bot using::

    uv run bots/basic_bot_and_ser_cpp.py

Pipeline::

    transport.input()
        ↓
    stt (MERaLiONSpeechTranslationService)
        ↓
    user_aggregator (LLMUserAggregator)
        ↓
    pre_llm_tagger (UserTurnPreLLMTagger)
        ↓
    llm (OpenAILLMService → llama.cpp)
        ↓
    tts (PiperTTSService)
        ↓
    transport.output()
        ↓
    assistant_aggregator (LLMAssistantAggregator)
"""

import asyncio
import os
import re
import subprocess
import sys
import urllib.parse
import urllib.request
from pathlib import Path

# Ensure UTF-8 output on Windows (avoids UnicodeEncodeError for non-ASCII in logs).
if sys.platform == "win32":
    sys.stdout.reconfigure(encoding="utf-8", errors="replace")
    sys.stderr.reconfigure(encoding="utf-8", errors="replace")

# Ensure the project root (pipecat-quickstart/) is on sys.path so local
# packages such as `processors/` are importable regardless of how the bot
# is launched (uv run, python -m, direct script invocation, etc.).
_PROJECT_ROOT = Path(__file__).resolve().parents[1]
if str(_PROJECT_ROOT) not in sys.path:
    sys.path.insert(0, str(_PROJECT_ROOT))

from dotenv import load_dotenv
from loguru import logger

print("Starting Pipecat bot...")
print("Loading models and imports (20 seconds, first run only)\n")

logger.info("Loading Silero VAD model...")
from pipecat.audio.vad.silero import SileroVADAnalyzer
from pipecat.audio.vad.vad_analyzer import VADParams

logger.info("✅ Silero VAD model loaded")

from pipecat.frames.frames import LLMRunFrame

logger.info("Loading pipeline components...")
from pipecat.pipeline.pipeline import Pipeline
from pipecat.pipeline.runner import PipelineRunner
from pipecat.pipeline.task import PipelineParams, PipelineTask
from pipecat.processors.aggregators.llm_context import LLMContext
from pipecat.processors.aggregators.llm_response_universal import (
    AssistantTurnStoppedMessage,
    LLMContextAggregatorPair,
    LLMUserAggregatorParams,
    UserTurnStoppedMessage,
)
from pipecat.processors.frame_processor import FrameDirection, FrameProcessor
from pipecat.runner.types import RunnerArguments
from pipecat.runner.utils import create_transport
from pipecat.services.openai.llm import OpenAILLMService
from pipecat.services.piper.tts import PiperTTSService
from pipecat.transports.base_transport import BaseTransport, TransportParams
from pipecat.turns.user_start import (
    TranscriptionUserTurnStartStrategy,
    VADUserTurnStartStrategy,
)
from pipecat.turns.user_stop import (
    SpeechTimeoutUserTurnStopStrategy,
)
from pipecat.turns.user_turn_strategies import UserTurnStrategies

from services.meralion_speech_translation import MERaLiONSpeechTranslationService

if os.name != "nt":
    try:
        from pipecat.transports.daily.transport import DailyParams
    except ModuleNotFoundError:
        DailyParams = None
else:
    DailyParams = None

logger.info("✅ All components loaded successfully!")

ENV_PATH = Path(__file__).resolve().parents[1] / ".env"
load_dotenv(dotenv_path=ENV_PATH, override=True)


def _resolve_llamacpp_model() -> str:
    """Return model name for the llama.cpp request (server-side this is usually ignored).

    Falls back to LLAMACPP_FINETUNED_MODEL name when LLAMACPP_MODEL is not set.
    """
    explicit = (os.getenv("LLAMACPP_MODEL") or "").strip()
    if explicit:
        return explicit
    finetuned = (os.getenv("LLAMACPP_FINETUNED_MODEL") or "").strip()
    if finetuned:
        return finetuned
    return "granite"


def _env_float(name: str, default: float) -> float:
    raw_value = os.getenv(name)
    if raw_value is None:
        return default
    try:
        return float(raw_value)
    except ValueError:
        logger.warning("Invalid %s='%s'; falling back to %s", name, raw_value, default)
        return default


def _env_int(name: str, default: int | None = None) -> int | None:
    raw_value = os.getenv(name)
    if raw_value is None:
        return default
    try:
        return int(raw_value)
    except ValueError:
        logger.warning("Invalid %s='%s'; falling back to %s", name, raw_value, default)
        return default


def _env_optional_float(name: str) -> float | None:
    raw_value = os.getenv(name)
    if raw_value is None or not raw_value.strip():
        return None
    try:
        return float(raw_value)
    except ValueError:
        logger.warning("Invalid %s='%s'; ignoring value", name, raw_value)
        return None


def _find_finetuned_model_path(model_name: str) -> Path:
    """Return the .gguf path for a finetuned model stored in training/outputs/<model_name>/."""
    base = _PROJECT_ROOT / "training" / "outputs" / model_name
    if not base.is_dir():
        raise FileNotFoundError(
            f"Finetuned model directory not found: {base}\n"
            f"Expected: training/outputs/{model_name}/"
        )
    exact = base / f"{model_name}.gguf"
    if exact.exists():
        return exact
    gguf_files = sorted(base.glob("*.gguf"))
    if not gguf_files:
        raise FileNotFoundError(f"No .gguf file found in {base}")
    if len(gguf_files) > 1:
        logger.warning(
            "Multiple .gguf files in {}; using {}",
            base,
            gguf_files[0].name,
        )
    else:
        logger.warning(
            "Expected {}.gguf; using {} instead",
            model_name,
            gguf_files[0].name,
        )
    return gguf_files[0]


def _server_is_up(base_url: str) -> bool:
    """Return True if the llama-server health endpoint responds successfully."""
    try:
        parsed = urllib.parse.urlparse(base_url)
        health_url = f"{parsed.scheme}://{parsed.netloc}/health"
        with urllib.request.urlopen(health_url, timeout=2) as resp:
            return resp.status == 200
    except Exception:
        return False


async def _autostart_llama_server() -> "subprocess.Popen | None":
    """Start llama-server as a subprocess when LLAMACPP_FINETUNED_MODEL is set.

    Resolves the GGUF from training/outputs/<name>/, checks whether a server is
    already listening, and if not starts one.  Returns the Popen object so the
    caller can terminate it on exit, or None if no auto-start was needed.
    """
    finetuned_name = (os.getenv("LLAMACPP_FINETUNED_MODEL") or "").strip()
    if not finetuned_name:
        return None

    model_path = _find_finetuned_model_path(finetuned_name)
    logger.info("Finetuned model resolved: {}", model_path)

    base_url = os.getenv("LLAMACPP_BASE_URL", "http://127.0.0.1:8080/v1")
    if await asyncio.to_thread(_server_is_up, base_url):
        logger.info(
            "llama-server already running at {} — skipping auto-start", base_url
        )
        return None

    parsed = urllib.parse.urlparse(base_url)
    host = parsed.hostname or "127.0.0.1"
    port = str(parsed.port or 8080)

    server_bin = os.getenv("LLAMACPP_SERVER_BIN", "llama-server")
    ctx_size = os.getenv("LLAMACPP_SERVER_CTX_SIZE", "4096")
    threads = os.getenv("LLAMACPP_SERVER_THREADS", "8")
    gpu_layers = os.getenv("LLAMACPP_SERVER_GPU_LAYERS", "0")
    reasoning = os.getenv("LLAMACPP_SERVER_REASONING", "off")

    cmd = [
        server_bin,
        "-m", str(model_path),
        "--host", host,
        "--port", port,
        "--ctx-size", ctx_size,
        "--threads", threads,
        "--n-gpu-layers", gpu_layers,
        "--reasoning", reasoning,
    ]
    logger.info("Auto-starting llama-server: {}", " ".join(cmd))

    proc = await asyncio.to_thread(
        subprocess.Popen,
        cmd,
        stdout=subprocess.PIPE,
        stderr=subprocess.STDOUT,
    )

    # Poll until ready (up to 120 s — first load of a large GGUF can be slow).
    for attempt in range(60):
        await asyncio.sleep(2)
        if await asyncio.to_thread(_server_is_up, base_url):
            logger.info("✅ llama-server ready at {} (waited ~{}s)", base_url, (attempt + 1) * 2)
            return proc
        if attempt % 5 == 4:
            logger.info("Still waiting for llama-server... ({}/120 s)", (attempt + 1) * 2)

    logger.warning(
        "llama-server did not become ready within 120 s — proceeding anyway"
    )
    return proc


def _build_llamacpp_settings() -> dict:
    """Collect generation parameters supported by the llama.cpp OpenAI-compatible API."""
    settings: dict = {}

    temperature = _env_optional_float("LLAMACPP_TEMPERATURE")
    if temperature is not None:
        settings["temperature"] = temperature

    top_p = _env_optional_float("LLAMACPP_TOP_P")
    if top_p is not None:
        settings["top_p"] = top_p

    max_tokens = _env_int("LLAMACPP_MAX_TOKENS")
    if max_tokens is not None:
        settings["max_tokens"] = max_tokens

    presence_penalty = _env_optional_float("LLAMACPP_PRESENCE_PENALTY")
    if presence_penalty is not None:
        settings["presence_penalty"] = presence_penalty

    frequency_penalty = _env_optional_float("LLAMACPP_FREQUENCY_PENALTY")
    if frequency_penalty is not None:
        settings["frequency_penalty"] = frequency_penalty

    return settings


def _resolve_system_prompt() -> str:
    system_prompt_file = (os.getenv("LLAMACPP_SYSTEM_PROMPT_FILE") or "").strip()
    inline_prompt = (os.getenv("LLAMACPP_SYSTEM_PROMPT") or "").strip()

    if system_prompt_file:
        prompt_path = Path(system_prompt_file).expanduser()
        if not prompt_path.is_absolute():
            prompt_path = (ENV_PATH.parent / prompt_path).resolve()

        try:
            prompt_from_file = prompt_path.read_text(encoding="utf-8").strip()
        except OSError as exc:
            logger.warning(
                "Unable to load LLAMACPP_SYSTEM_PROMPT_FILE='{}': {}",
                prompt_path,
                exc,
            )
            return inline_prompt

        if not prompt_from_file:
            logger.warning(
                "LLAMACPP_SYSTEM_PROMPT_FILE='{}' is empty; falling back to LLAMACPP_SYSTEM_PROMPT",
                prompt_path,
            )
            return inline_prompt

        if inline_prompt:
            logger.warning(
                "Both LLAMACPP_SYSTEM_PROMPT_FILE and LLAMACPP_SYSTEM_PROMPT are set; using file prompt"
            )

        logger.info("Loaded system prompt from file: {}", prompt_path)
        return prompt_from_file

    return inline_prompt


async def run_bot(transport: BaseTransport, runner_args: RunnerArguments):
    logger.info("Starting bot")
    logger.info("Loaded env from: {}", ENV_PATH)

    server_proc = await _autostart_llama_server()

    llamacpp_model = _resolve_llamacpp_model()
    llamacpp_base_url = os.getenv("LLAMACPP_BASE_URL", "http://127.0.0.1:8080/v1")
    logger.info("Using llama.cpp model: {} @ {}", llamacpp_model, llamacpp_base_url)
    llamacpp_settings = _build_llamacpp_settings()
    logger.info("llama.cpp generation settings: {}", llamacpp_settings)
    system_prompt = _resolve_system_prompt()
    if system_prompt:
        logger.info("Custom system prompt enabled")

    user_turn_count = 0
    _last_counted_msg_index: int = -1
    _conversation_started = False
    vad_stop_secs = _env_float("VAD_STOP_SECS", 0.8)
    user_turn_stop_timeout = _env_float("USER_TURN_STOP_TIMEOUT", 10.0)

    def _update_system_turn_metadata(turn: int) -> None:
        """Atomically replace the live <session_state> block with updated user_turn.

        never touches the <session_state at="example-N"> blocks in the few-shot
        examples section.
        """
        _live_re = re.compile(r'<session_state>(.*?)</session_state>', re.DOTALL)
        messages = context.get_messages()
        for i in range(len(messages)):
            if messages[i].get("role") == "system":
                content = messages[i]["content"]
                m = _live_re.search(content)
                if m:
                    new_block = (
                        f"<session_state>"
                        f"\n  <user_turn>{turn}</user_turn>"
                        f"\n</session_state>"
                    )
                    messages[i]["content"] = _live_re.sub(new_block, content, count=1)
                else:
                    new_block = (
                        f"<session_state>"
                        f"\n  <user_turn>{turn}</user_turn>"
                        f"\n</session_state>"
                    )
                    messages[i]["content"] = content.rstrip("\n") + f"\n\n{new_block}"
                return

        context.add_message(
            {"role": "system", "content": f"<session_state>\n  <user_turn>{turn}</user_turn>\n</session_state>"}

        nonlocal user_turn_count, _last_counted_msg_index
        messages = context.get_messages()
        for i in range(len(messages) - 1, -1, -1):
            if messages[i].get("role") != "user":
                continue

            content = messages[i].get("content", "")
            if i == _last_counted_msg_index:
                return False, content

            user_turn_count += 1
            _last_counted_msg_index = i
            _update_system_turn_metadata(user_turn_count)
            return True, content

            if direction != FrameDirection.DOWNSTREAM:
                await self.push_frame(frame, direction)

            # Tag here so the same-turn LLM request includes [UserTurn N].
            tagged, tagged_content = _tag_latest_user_message_if_needed()

    )

def _dir_size_bytes(path: Path) -> int:
    return sum(f.stat().st_size for f in path.rglob("*") if f.is_file())


def main() -> None:
    args = _parse_args()

    try:
        from huggingface_hub import snapshot_download
        from huggingface_hub.errors import GatedRepoError, RepositoryNotFoundError

    args.output_dir.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)

"""HTTP server for MERaLiON-OmniVoice-Hokkien-TTS.

There is no official inference server for OmniVoice-based models (only a
Python API and a Gradio demo), so this wraps the `omnivoice` library in a
small FastAPI service that returns synthesized WAV audio over HTTP — the

import argparse
import io
import os
import tempfile
from contextlib import asynccontextmanager
from pathlib import Path
from typing import Optional

from dotenv import load_dotenv
from fastapi import FastAPI, Form, HTTPException, Request, UploadFile
from fastapi.responses import Response
from loguru import logger

_PROJECT_ROOT = Path(__file__).resolve().parents[1]
load_dotenv(dotenv_path=_PROJECT_ROOT / ".env", override=True)

DEFAULT_MODEL_DIR = _PROJECT_ROOT / "models" / "MERaLiON-OmniVoice-Hokkien-TTS"

_DTYPE_NAMES = {"float16", "float32", "bfloat16"}


class ModelState:
    """Holds the loaded model and a lock so requests are serialized on one GPU."""

    def __init__(self):
        self.model = None
        self.lock = None
        self.default_voice_prompt = None
        self.default_instruct: Optional[str] = None


state = ModelState()


def _resolve_device(requested: str) -> str:
    import torch

    if requested != "auto":
        return requested
    if torch.cuda.is_available():
        return "cuda:0"
    if getattr(torch.backends, "mps", None) and torch.backends.mps.is_available():
        return "mps"
    return "cpu"


def _resolve_dtype(name: str, device: str):
    import torch

    if device == "cpu" and name == "float16":
        logger.warning("float16 is not well supported on CPU; using float32 instead")
        name = "float32"
    return {"float16": torch.float16, "float32": torch.float32, "bfloat16": torch.bfloat16}[name]


def _load_model(model_dir: str, device: str, dtype_name: str):
    import asyncio

    from omnivoice import OmniVoice

    resolved_device = _resolve_device(device)
    dtype = _resolve_dtype(dtype_name, resolved_device)

    logger.info("Loading MERaLiON-OmniVoice-Hokkien-TTS from {} (device={})", model_dir, resolved_device)
    model = OmniVoice.from_pretrained(model_dir, device_map=resolved_device, dtype=dtype)
    logger.info("✅ Model loaded (sampling_rate={})", model.sampling_rate)

    state.model = model
    state.lock = asyncio.Lock()


@asynccontextmanager
async def lifespan(app: FastAPI):
    args = app.state.cli_args
    _load_model(args.model_dir, args.device, args.dtype)

    if args.default_ref_audio:
        logger.info("Building default voice-clone prompt from {}", args.default_ref_audio)
        state.default_voice_prompt = state.model.create_voice_clone_prompt(
            ref_audio=args.default_ref_audio,
            ref_text=args.default_ref_text,
        )
    elif args.default_instruct:
        state.default_instruct = args.default_instruct

    yield

    state.model = None


app = FastAPI(title="MERaLiON-OmniVoice-Hokkien-TTS server", lifespan=lifespan)


def _check_api_key(request: Request) -> None:
    api_key = request.app.state.cli_args.api_key
    if not api_key:
        return
    header = request.headers.get("authorization", "")
    token = header.removeprefix("Bearer ").strip()
    if token != api_key:
        raise HTTPException(status_code=401, detail="Invalid or missing API key")


@app.get("/health")
async def health():
    return {
        "status": "ok" if state.model is not None else "loading",
        "sampling_rate": getattr(state.model, "sampling_rate", None),
    }


@app.post("/v1/audio/speech")
async def synthesize(
    request: Request,
    text: str = Form(...),
    language: str = Form("nan"),
    ref_text: Optional[str] = Form(None),
    instruct: Optional[str] = Form(None),
    speed: float = Form(1.0),
    num_step: int = Form(32),
    ref_audio: Optional[UploadFile] = None,
):
    _check_api_key(request)

    if state.model is None:
        raise HTTPException(status_code=503, detail="Model is still loading")

    if not text.strip():
        raise HTTPException(status_code=400, detail="`text` must not be empty")

    generate_kwargs = {
        "text": text,
        "language": language,
        "speed": speed,
        "num_step": num_step,
    }

    tmp_ref_path: Optional[str] = None
    try:
        if ref_audio is not None:
            suffix = Path(ref_audio.filename or "ref.wav").suffix or ".wav"
            with tempfile.NamedTemporaryFile(suffix=suffix, delete=False) as tmp:
                tmp.write(await ref_audio.read())
                tmp_ref_path = tmp.name
            generate_kwargs["ref_audio"] = tmp_ref_path
            if ref_text:
                generate_kwargs["ref_text"] = ref_text
        elif instruct:
            generate_kwargs["instruct"] = instruct
        elif state.default_voice_prompt is not None:
            generate_kwargs["voice_clone_prompt"] = state.default_voice_prompt
        elif state.default_instruct:
            generate_kwargs["instruct"] = state.default_instruct

        async with state.lock:
            import asyncio

            audios = await asyncio.to_thread(state.model.generate, **generate_kwargs)
    except Exception as exc:  # noqa: BLE001 - surface inference errors to the client
        logger.exception("TTS generation failed")
        raise HTTPException(status_code=500, detail=str(exc)) from exc
    finally:
        if tmp_ref_path is not None:
            os.unlink(tmp_ref_path)

    import soundfile as sf

    buffer = io.BytesIO()
    sf.write(buffer, audios[0], state.model.sampling_rate, format="WAV")
    return Response(content=buffer.getvalue(), media_type="audio/wav")


def _parse_args() -> argparse.Namespace:
    parser = argparse.ArgumentParser(description=__doc__)
    parser.add_argument("--model-dir", default=str(DEFAULT_MODEL_DIR), help="Local model dir or HF repo id.")
    parser.add_argument("--host", default=os.getenv("MERALION_TTS_HOST", "127.0.0.1"))

        help="'auto', 'cuda:0', 'mps', or 'cpu'.",

        default=os.getenv("MERALION_TTS_DTYPE", "float16"),
        choices=sorted(_DTYPE_NAMES),

        "--default-ref-audio",
        default=os.getenv("MERALION_TTS_DEFAULT_REF_AUDIO"),

        "--api-key",
        default=os.getenv("MERALION_TTS_API_KEY"),
        help="If set, requests must send 'Authorization: Bearer <key>'.",
    )
    return parser.parse_args()

    import uvicorn

    args = _parse_args()

    if args.default_ref_audio and not args.default_ref_text:
        raise SystemExit("--default-ref-text is required when --default-ref-audio is set")

    app.state.cli_args = args

## Evaluation
...
### Metrics


#### 1. Language Identification (LangID)


What: An audio-based classifier determines whether each generated utterance sounds
like Hokkien or Mandarin.


Why: The core challenge for Hokkien TTS is that most systems default to Mandarin
pronunciation when reading Chinese characters. A model that produces Mandarin
speech — regardless of how accurate or natural it sounds — has fundamentally failed
at the task. LangID is therefore a gate metric: it tells us whether the model is even attempting the right language.


How: [Qwen 3.5 Omni Plus](https://qwen.ai/blog?id=qwen3.5-omni) listens to each audio clip and classifies it as Hokkien or Mandarin based on
pronunciation and tonal patterns (not text content). The prompt explicitly
instructs the model to focus on phonetic features and to treat Singapore Hokkien
loanwords as Hokkien.

### Metrics
...
#### 2. Word Error Rate (WER)


What: Character-level WER between the original text and an ASR transcription of the
generated audio.


Why: WER measures whether the model is saying the right words. A low WER means the
generated speech faithfully reproduces the input text. We compute character-level
WER (each Chinese character is a token) because Hokkien text has no standard
word segmentation.


How: We use two independent ASR systems for robustness:


• Qwen 3.5 Omni Plus — prompted as a Hokkien transcription expert. Samples classified as Mandarin by
LangID are penalized to WER=1.0 (since producing the wrong language is a total
failure regardless of word accuracy).
• MERaLiON-3-3B-ASR — a local multilingual speech model. We report both raw scores and scores with
the same LangID penalty applied.


...

## Evaluation

### Metrics
...
#### 3. Naturalness (MOS-like)


What: A 1–10 rating of how natural and human-like each utterance sounds.


Why: A model can pronounce words correctly but still sound robotic, choppy, or
unnatural. Naturalness captures the perceptual quality — prosody, rhythm, fluency,
voice quality, and absence of artifacts — that determines whether the speech is
pleasant to listen to.


How: Qwen 3.5 Omni Plus rates each clip on a 1–10 scale, evaluating prosody,
fluency, voice quality, pronunciation correctness, and artifacts. The evaluator is
prompted with expertise in Hokkien and Chinese dialects.

#### 4. DNSMOS P.835


What: An objective signal-quality score (1–5 scale) predicted by Microsoft's DNSMOS
model.


Why: DNSMOS provides a language-agnostic signal quality assessment. It measures speech distortion (SIG), background
noise (BAK), and overall quality (OVRL) without any dependence on language
understanding. This complements the LLM-based metrics by catching low-level audio quality
issues (clipping, noise, codec artifacts) that a language model might overlook.


How: Microsoft's pre-trained ONNX model (P.835 framework) runs locally on each audio
file. No API calls or language-specific configuration needed.

achieve high DNSMOS scores because the audio is clean — but they are speaking the

# 🔥 MERaLiON-TTS 🔥


🚀 MERaLiON-OmniVoice-Hokkien-TTS


MERaLiON-OmniVoice-Hokkien-TTS is a fine-tuned text-to-speech model that
generates natural-sounding Singapore Hokkien (Southern Min / 闽南语) speech from Chinese character input. It is built on [OmniVoice](https://huggingface.co/k2-fsa/OmniVoice) and fine-tuned on Hokkien conversational data using SFT (Supervised Finetuning)
and GRPO (Group Relative Policy Optimization).


Hokkien is an under-resourced language in the TTS space. Many Chinese TTS
systems produce Mandarin pronunciation even when given Hokkien text written in Chinese
characters. This model addresses that gap by generating speech with authentic
Hokkien pronunciation, tones, and prosody.

OmniVoice is a state-of-the-art massively multilingual zero-shot text-to-speech
(TTS) model supporting over 600 languages. Built on a novel diffusion language

## Python API


OmniVoice supports three generation modes. All features in this section are also
available via command-line tools.


### Voice Cloning


Clone a voice from a short reference audio. Provide `ref_audio` and `ref_text`:

 from omnivoice import OmniVoice
import soundfile as sf
import torch

model = OmniVoice.from_pretrained(
    "k2-fsa/OmniVoice",
    device_map="cuda:0",
    dtype=torch.float16
)

audio = model.generate(
    text="Hello, this is a test of zero-shot voice cloning.",
    ref_audio="ref.wav",
    ref_text="Transcription of the reference audio.",
) # audio is a list of `np.ndarray` with shape (T,) at 24 kHz.

# If you don't want to input `ref_text` manually, you can directly omit the
`ref_text`.

...

sf.write("out.wav", audio[0], 24000)

#### Reusing a cloned voice across sessions


Encode the reference audio once, save the resulting prompt, and skip the audio
loading / auto-transcription steps in later sessions:

 prompt = model.create_voice_clone_prompt(
    ref_audio="ref.wav", ref_text="Transcription of the reference audio."
)
prompt.save("my_voice.pt")

...

...
# Later, in a new session:
from omnivoice import VoiceClonePrompt

prompt = VoiceClonePrompt.load("my_voice.pt")
audio = model.generate(text="Hello again!", voice_clone_prompt=prompt)
> 


Tips


• 
Use a 3–10 seconds reference audio clip. Longer audio slows down inference and
may degrade cloning quality.
• 
For standard pronunciation, use a reference audio in the same language as the target speech. In cross-lingual voice cloning (i.e., the reference audio
and target speech are in different languages), the generated speech will carry
an accent from the reference audio's language.
• 
For better results with Arabic numerals, normalize them to words first (e.g.,
"123" → "one hundred twenty-three"). You can pass `normalize_text=True` to `generate()` to do this automatically (opt-in; install the extra with `pip install "omnivoice[tn]"`, which pulls in [WeTextProcessing](https://github.com/wenet-e2e/WeTextProcessing)):

### Voice Design


Describe the desired voice with speaker attributes — no reference audio needed.
Supported attributes: gender (male/female), age (child to elderly), pitch (very low to very high), style (whisper), English accent (American, British, etc.), and Chinese dialect (四川话, 陕西话, etc.). Attributes are comma-separated and freely combinable across
categories.

 audio = model.generate(
    text="Hello, this is a test of zero-shot voice design.",
    instruct="female, low pitch, british accent",
)
> 


Note: The model is primarily trained on the voice cloning task, so voice cloning is
the most stable mode. Voice design is trained on Chinese and English data only.
It can generalize to other languages, but may produce unstable results for some
low-resource languages or edge cases.


See [docs/voice-design.md](https://pypi.org/project/omnivoice/docs/voice-design.md) for the full attribute reference, Chinese equivalents, and usage tips.

### Auto Voice


Let the model choose a voice automatically:

 audio = model.generate(text="This is a sentence without any voice prompt.")

### Generation Parameters


All above three modes share the same `model.generate()` API. You can further control the generation behavior via keyword arguments:

 audio = model.generate(
    text="...",
    num_step=32,  # diffusion steps (or 16 for faster inference)
    speed=1.0,     # speed factor (>1.0 faster, <1.0 slower)
    duration=10.0, # fixed output duration in seconds (overrides speed)
    # ... more options
)

See more detailed control in [docs/generation-parameters.md](https://pypi.org/project/omnivoice/docs/generation-parameters.md).

### Non-Verbal & Pronunciation Control


OmniVoice supports inline non-verbal symbols and pronunciation correction within the input text.


Non-verbal symbols: Insert tags like `[laughter]` directly in the text to add expressive non-verbal sounds.

 audio = model.generate(text="[laughter] You really got me. I didn't see that coming at all.")

Supported tags: `[laughter]`, `[sigh]`, `[confirmation-en]`, `[question-en]`, `[question-ah]`, `[question-oh]`, `[question-ei]`, `[question-yi]`, `[surprise-ah]`, `[surprise-oh]`, `[surprise-wa]`, `[surprise-yo]`, `[dissatisfaction-hnn]`.


Pronunciation control (Chinese): Use pinyin with tone numbers to correct specific character pronunciations.

### Batch Inference


`omnivoice-infer-batch` can distribute batch inference across multiple GPUs, designed for large-scale
TTS tasks.

 omnivoice-infer-batch \
    --model k2-fsa/OmniVoice \
    --test_list test.jsonl \
    --res_dir results/

The test list is a JSONL file where each line is a JSON object:

 {"id": "sample_001", "text": "Hello world", "ref_audio": "/path/to/ref.wav", "ref_text": "Reference transcript", "instruct": "female, british accent", "language_id": "en", "duration": 10.0, "speed": 1.0}

Only `id` and `text` are mandatory fields. `ref_audio` and `ref_text` are used in voice cloning mode. `instruct` is used in voice design mode. If no reference audio or instruct are provided,
the model will generate text in a random voice.

## Key Features


• 600+ Languages Supported: The broadest language coverage among zero-shot TTS models.
• Voice Cloning: State-of-the-art voice cloning quality from a short reference audio.
• Voice Design: Control voices via assigned speaker attributes (gender, age, pitch,
dialect/accent, whisper, etc.).
• Fine-grained Control: Non-verbal symbols (e.g., `[laughter]`) and pronunciation correction via pinyin or phonemes.
• Fast Inference: RTF as low as 0.025 (40x faster than real-time).
• Diffusion Language Model-style Architecture: A clean, streamlined, and scalable design that delivers both quality and
speed.

#
# Copyright (c) 2024-2026, Daily
#
# SPDX-License-Identifier: BSD 2-Clause License
#

"""MERaLiON-OmniVoice-Hokkien-TTS service for Pipecat.

Talks to the local HTTP server started by ``scripts/serve_meralion_tts.py``,
which owns the loaded OmniVoice model (and optionally a pinned default
voice). This client only POSTs text and streams back the WAV response.
"""

from collections.abc import AsyncGenerator
from dataclasses import dataclass

import aiohttp
from loguru import logger

from pipecat.frames.frames import ErrorFrame, Frame, TTSStoppedFrame
from pipecat.services.settings import TTSSettings
from pipecat.services.tts_service import TTSService
from pipecat.utils.tracing.service_decorators import traced_tts


@dataclass
class MERaLiONTTSSettings(TTSSettings):
    """Settings for MERaLiONTTSService."""

    pass


class MERaLiONTTSService(TTSService):
    """Hokkien text-to-speech via a local MERaLiON-OmniVoice-Hokkien-TTS server."""

    Settings = MERaLiONTTSSettings
    _settings: Settings

    def __init__(
        self,
        *,
        base_url: str,
        aiohttp_session: aiohttp.ClientSession,
        api_key: str | None = None,
        language: str = "nan",
        instruct: str | None = None,
        speed: float = 1.0,
        num_step: int = 32,
        request_timeout: float = 60.0,
        settings: Settings | None = None,
        **kwargs,
    ):
        """Initialize the MERaLiON TTS service.

        Args:
            base_url: Base URL of the running serve_meralion_tts.py server.
            aiohttp_session: aiohttp ClientSession for making HTTP requests.
            api_key: Bearer token, if the server was started with --api-key.
            language: ISO 639-3 code for the target language ("nan" = Hokkien).
            instruct: Voice-design attributes (e.g. "female, low pitch") sent with
                every request. Ignored if the server was started with a pinned
                default voice/ref audio — that takes precedence server-side only
                when this is omitted.
            speed: Speaking rate passed to the model (>1.0 faster, <1.0 slower).
            num_step: Diffusion steps; lower is faster but may reduce quality.
            request_timeout: HTTP request timeout in seconds.
            settings: Runtime-updatable settings.
            **kwargs: Additional arguments passed to the parent TTSService.
        """
        default_settings = self.Settings(model=None, voice=None, language=None)
        if settings is not None:
            default_settings.apply_update(settings)

        super().__init__(
            push_start_frame=True,
            push_stop_frames=True,
            settings=default_settings,
            **kwargs,
        )

        if base_url.endswith("/"):
            base_url = base_url[:-1]

        self._base_url = base_url
        self._session = aiohttp_session
        self._api_key = api_key
        self._language = language
        self._instruct = instruct
        self._speed = speed
        self._num_step = num_step
        self._request_timeout = aiohttp.ClientTimeout(total=request_timeout)

    def can_generate_metrics(self) -> bool:
        """Check if this service can generate processing metrics.

        Returns:
            True, as this service supports metrics generation.
        """
        return True

    @traced_tts
    async def run_tts(self, text: str, context_id: str) -> AsyncGenerator[Frame, None]:
        """Generate speech from text using the MERaLiON TTS HTTP server.

        Args:
            text: The text to convert to speech.
            context_id: Unique identifier for this TTS context.

        Yields:
            Frame: Audio frames containing the synthesized speech and status frames.
        """
        headers = {}
        if self._api_key:
            headers["Authorization"] = f"Bearer {self._api_key}"

        data = aiohttp.FormData()
        data.add_field("text", text)
        data.add_field("language", self._language)
        data.add_field("speed", str(self._speed))
        data.add_field("num_step", str(self._num_step))
        if self._instruct:
            data.add_field("instruct", self._instruct)

        try:
            async with self._session.post(
                f"{self._base_url}/v1/audio/speech",
                data=data,
                headers=headers,
                timeout=self._request_timeout,
            ) as response:
                if response.status != 200:
                    error = await response.text()
                    yield ErrorFrame(
                        error=f"Error getting audio (status: {response.status}, error: {error})"
                    )
                    yield TTSStoppedFrame(context_id=context_id)
                    return

                await self.start_tts_usage_metrics(text)

                async for frame in self._stream_audio_frames_from_iterator(
                    response.content.iter_chunked(self.chunk_size),
                    strip_wav_header=True,
                    context_id=context_id,
                ):
                    await self.stop_ttfb_metrics()
                    yield frame
        except Exception as e:
            logger.error(f"{self} exception: {e}")
            yield ErrorFrame(error=f"Unknown error occurred: {e}")
        finally:
            await self.stop_ttfb_metrics()

"""MERaLiON-OmniVoice-Hokkien-TTS service for Pipecat.

Talks to the local HTTP server started by ``scripts/serve_meralion_tts.py``,
which owns the loaded OmniVoice model (and optionally a pinned default
voice). This client only POSTs text and streams back the WAV response.
"""

from collections.abc import AsyncGenerator
from dataclasses import dataclass

import aiohttp
from loguru import logger

from pipecat.frames.frames import ErrorFrame, Frame, TTSStoppedFrame
from pipecat.services.settings import TTSSettings
from pipecat.services.tts_service import TTSService
from pipecat.utils.tracing.service_decorators import traced_tts


@dataclass
class MERaLiONTTSSettings(TTSSettings):
    """Settings for MERaLiONTTSService."""

    pass


class MERaLiONTTSService(TTSService):
    """Hokkien text-to-speech via a local MERaLiON-OmniVoice-Hokkien-TTS server."""

    Settings = MERaLiONTTSSettings
    _settings: Settings

    def __init__(
        self,
        *,
        base_url: str,
        aiohttp_session: aiohttp.ClientSession,
        api_key: str | None = None,
        language: str = "nan",
        instruct: str | None = None,
        speed: float = 1.0,
        num_step: int = 32,
        request_timeout: float = 60.0,
        settings: Settings | None = None,
        **kwargs,
    ):
        """Initialize the MERaLiON TTS service.

        Args:
            base_url: Base URL of the running serve_meralion_tts.py server.
            aiohttp_session: aiohttp ClientSession for making HTTP requests.
            api_key: Bearer token, if the server was started with --api-key.
            language: ISO 639-3 code for the target language ("nan" = Hokkien).
            instruct: Voice-design attributes (e.g. "female, low pitch") sent with
                every request. Ignored if the server was started with a pinned
                default voice/ref audio — that takes precedence server-side only
                when this is omitted.
            speed: Speaking rate passed to the model (>1.0 faster, <1.0 slower).
            num_step: Diffusion steps; lower is faster but may reduce quality.
            request_timeout: HTTP request timeout in seconds.
            settings: Runtime-updatable settings.
            **kwargs: Additional arguments passed to the parent TTSService.
        """
        default_settings = self.Settings(model=None, voice=None, language=None)
        if settings is not None:
            default_settings.apply_update(settings)

        super().__init__(
            push_start_frame=True,
            push_stop_frames=True,
            settings=default_settings,
            **kwargs,
        )

        if base_url.endswith("/"):
            base_url = base_url[:-1]

        self._base_url = base_url
        self._session = aiohttp_session
        self._api_key = api_key
        self._language = language
        self._instruct = instruct
        self._speed = speed
        self._num_step = num_step
        self._request_timeout = aiohttp.ClientTimeout(total=request_timeout)

    def can_generate_metrics(self) -> bool:
        """Check if this service can generate processing metrics.

        Returns:
            True, as this service supports metrics generation.
        """
        return True

    @traced_tts
    async def run_tts(self, text: str, context_id: str) -> AsyncGenerator[Frame, None]:
        """Generate speech from text using the MERaLiON TTS HTTP server.

        Args:
            text: The text to convert to speech.
            context_id: Unique identifier for this TTS context.

        Yields:
            Frame: Audio frames containing the synthesized speech and status frames.
        """
        headers = {}
        if self._api_key:
            headers["Authorization"] = f"Bearer {self._api_key}"

        data = aiohttp.FormData()
        data.add_field("text", text)
        data.add_field("language", self._language)
        data.add_field("speed", str(self._speed))
        data.add_field("num_step", str(self._num_step))
        if self._instruct:
            data.add_field("instruct", self._instruct)

        try:
            async with self._session.post(
                f"{self._base_url}/v1/audio/speech",
                data=data,
                headers=headers,
                timeout=self._request_timeout,
            ) as response:
                if response.status != 200:
                    error = await response.text()
                    yield ErrorFrame(
                        error=f"Error getting audio (status: {response.status}, error: {error})"
                    )
                    yield TTSStoppedFrame(context_id=context_id)
                    return

                await self.start_tts_usage_metrics(text)

                async for frame in self._stream_audio_frames_from_iterator(
                    response.content.iter_chunked(self.chunk_size),
                    strip_wav_header=True,
                    context_id=context_id,
                ):
                    await self.stop_ttfb_metrics()
                    yield frame
        except Exception as e:
            logger.error(f"{self} exception: {e}")
            yield ErrorFrame(error=f"Unknown error occurred: {e}")
        finally:
            await self.stop_ttfb_metrics()

Fortunately, bot.py already has a hokkien_renderer that converts English into genuine Hokkien Hanji via MERaLiON-3-10B before handing text off to TTS, so the pipeline is already set up to feed the right kind of input text into this step. So the only ways to bias toward Hokkien are writing the input text with genuine Hokkien vocabulary and phrasing rather than Mandarin-equivalent characters, and choosing between the two available voices.

Given that earlier benchmarks showed Qwen3 TTS Flash achieving perfect Hokkien identification when fed properly-written Hokkien Hanji text, the strategy is clear: keep the existing hokkien_renderer step that converts the English answer into genuine Hokkien wording before feeding it to the TTS input, since that's already how the pipeline works. """OpenRouter Qwen-Audio-3.0-TTS-Flash service for Pipecat.

Cloud fallback for MERaLiONTTSService when local OmniVoice inference is too
slow for real-time use.

Hokkien caveat: qwen/qwen-audio-3.0-tts-flash's system voices only cover
Mandarin Chinese and English (see Alibaba's Qwen-Audio-TTS voice list —
longanhuan_v3.6 and loongjohn, the two voices exposed on OpenRouter, are
Mandarin/English only; the one dialect voice this model family offers is
Sichuanese, not Hokkien/Minnan). OpenRouter's /audio/speech schema for this
model exposes only `model`, `input`, `voice`, `response_format`, and `speed`
— there is no language/dialect/instruction parameter to request Hokkien
pronunciation. Feeding it Hokkien Hanji text will be read aloud with Mandarin
pronunciation, not Hokkien. There is no reliable way to prompt this specific
model into speaking Hokkien; plain written Chinese is the practical ceiling.
"""

from collections.abc import AsyncGenerator
from dataclasses import dataclass

import aiohttp
from loguru import logger

from pipecat.frames.frames import ErrorFrame, Frame, TTSStoppedFrame
from pipecat.services.settings import TTSSettings
from pipecat.services.tts_service import TTSService
from pipecat.utils.tracing.service_decorators import traced_tts


@dataclass
class OpenRouterTTSSettings(TTSSettings):
    """Settings for OpenRouterTTSService."""

    pass


class OpenRouterTTSService(TTSService):
    """Text-to-speech via OpenRouter's qwen/qwen-audio-3.0-tts-flash endpoint."""

    Settings = OpenRouterTTSSettings
    _settings: Settings

    def __init__(
        self,
        *,
        api_key: str,
        aiohttp_session: aiohttp.ClientSession,
        base_url: str = "https://openrouter.ai/api/v1",
        model: str = "qwen/qwen-audio-3.0-tts-flash",
        voice: str = "longanhuan_v3.6",
        pcm_sample_rate: int = 24000,
        http_referer: str | None = None,
        title: str | None = None,
        request_timeout: float = 30.0,
        settings: Settings | None = None,
        **kwargs,
    ):
        """Initialize the OpenRouter TTS service.

        Args:
            api_key: OpenRouter API key.
            aiohttp_session: aiohttp ClientSession for making HTTP requests.
            base_url: OpenRouter's OpenAI-compatible base URL.
            model: OpenRouter TTS model slug.
            voice: Provider-specific voice identifier (Mandarin/English only
                for qwen-audio-3.0-tts-flash — see module docstring).
            pcm_sample_rate: Sample rate of the raw PCM audio DashScope returns.
                Not documented by OpenRouter; 24000 matches DashScope's own
                Qwen-Audio-TTS quickstart examples. Override if audio sounds
                pitch-shifted/sped up.
            http_referer: Optional site URL sent for OpenRouter app rankings.
            title: Optional site name sent for OpenRouter app rankings.
            request_timeout: HTTP request timeout in seconds.
            settings: Runtime-updatable settings.
            **kwargs: Additional arguments passed to the parent TTSService.
        """
        default_settings = self.Settings(model=None, voice=None, language=None)
        if settings is not None:
            default_settings.apply_update(settings)

        super().__init__(
            push_start_frame=True,
            push_stop_frames=True,
            settings=default_settings,
            **kwargs,
        )

        self._base_url = base_url.rstrip("/")
        self._session = aiohttp_session
        self._api_key = api_key
        self._model = model
        self._voice = voice
        self._pcm_sample_rate = pcm_sample_rate
        self._http_referer = http_referer
        self._title = title
        self._request_timeout = aiohttp.ClientTimeout(total=request_timeout)

    def can_generate_metrics(self) -> bool:
        """Check if this service can generate processing metrics.

        Returns:
            True, as this service supports metrics generation.
        """
        return True

    @traced_tts
    async def run_tts(self, text: str, context_id: str) -> AsyncGenerator[Frame, None]:
        """Generate speech from text using OpenRouter's TTS endpoint.

        Args:
            text: The text to convert to speech.
            context_id: Unique identifier for this TTS context.

        Yields:
            Frame: Audio frames containing the synthesized speech and status frames.
        """
        headers = {
            "Authorization": f"Bearer {self._api_key}",
            "Content-Type": "application/json",
        }
        if self._http_referer:
            headers["HTTP-Referer"] = self._http_referer
        if self._title:
            headers["X-Title"] = self._title

        payload = {
            "model": self._model,
            "input": text,
            "voice": self._voice,
            "response_format": "pcm",
        }

        try:
            async with self._session.post(
                f"{self._base_url}/audio/speech",
                json=payload,
                headers=headers,
                timeout=self._request_timeout,
            ) as response:
                if response.status != 200:
                    error = await response.text()
                    yield ErrorFrame(
                        error=f"Error getting audio (status: {response.status}, error: {error})"
                    )
                    yield TTSStoppedFrame(context_id=context_id)
                    return

                await self.start_tts_usage_metrics(text)

                async for frame in self._stream_audio_frames_from_iterator(
                    response.content.iter_chunked(self.chunk_size),
                    in_sample_rate=self._pcm_sample_rate,
                    context_id=context_id,
                ):
                    await self.stop_ttfb_metrics()
                    yield frame
        except Exception as e:
            logger.error(f"{self} exception: {e}")
            yield ErrorFrame(error=f"Unknown error occurred: {e}")
        finally:
            await self.stop_ttfb_metrics()

# OpenRouter APIs — Qwen: Qwen-Audio-3.0-TTS Flash (qwen/qwen-audio-3.0-tts-flash)

Guide for calling every confirmed OpenRouter API that serves `qwen/qwen-audio-3.0-tts-flash`.

Model page: https://openrouter.ai/qwen/qwen-audio-3.0-tts-flash
Create an API key: https://openrouter.ai/settings/keys

## Authentication

Send this header with every request:

- Authorization: Bearer $OPENROUTER_API_KEY

## Text-to-Speech API

Synthesize audio with `qwen/qwen-audio-3.0-tts-flash` through OpenRouter's Text-to-Speech API.

Docs: https://openrouter.ai/docs/api/api-reference/tts/create-speech

### Endpoint

POST https://openrouter.ai/api/v1/audio/speech

Headers:
- Content-Type: application/json

### Request fields (qwen/qwen-audio-3.0-tts-flash)

- model: string (required) — `"qwen/qwen-audio-3.0-tts-flash"`
- input: string (required) — text to synthesize
- voice: "loongjohn" | "longanhuan_v3.6" (optional) — provider-specific voice identifier
- response_format: "mp3" | "pcm" (optional) — output audio encoding; defaults to pcm

### Response

Success returns raw audio bytes, not JSON.

- `Content-Type` identifies the audio encoding, such as `audio/mpeg` or `audio/pcm`.
- `X-Generation-Id` identifies the billed generation.
- Write the response body directly to an audio file; do not call `response.json()`.

### Examples

#### Text to Speech

```bash
curl https://openrouter.ai/api/v1/audio/speech \
  -H "Content-Type: application/json" \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer $OPENROUTER_API_KEY" \
  --output output.mp3 \
  -d '{
  "model": "qwen/qwen-audio-3.0-tts-flash",
  "input": "The warm light flows across the OpenRouter office as the evening settles in and the routing never stops. One interface, hundreds of models. Ready when you are.",
  "voice": "loongjohn",
  "response_format": "mp3"
}'
```

### Error differences

- 400 — malformed audio input or an audio option the routed provider does not support
- 502 — the upstream audio operation failed

## Errors

Failures return `{"error": {"code": <number>, "message": <string>}}` with the HTTP status:

- 400 — malformed request or an unsupported parameter
- 401 — missing or invalid API key
- 402 — insufficient credits
- 403 — spend limit reached, key disabled, or access blocked
- 404 — unknown model or no provider can serve the request
- 429 — rate limited; retry with backoff
- 502 — the operation failed upstream; failed generations are not billed

---

def _env_float(name: str, default: float) -> float:
    raw_value = os.getenv(name)
    if raw_value is None:
        return default
    try:
        return float(raw_value)
    except ValueError:
        logger.warning("Invalid %s='%s'; falling back to %s", name, raw_value, default)
        return default


def _env_int(name: str, default: int | None = None) -> int | None:
    raw_value = os.getenv(name)
    if raw_value is None:

    try:

    except ValueError:

def _env_optional_float(name: str) -> float | None:
    raw_value = os.getenv(name)
    if raw_value is None or not raw_value.strip():
        return None
    try:
        return float(raw_value)
    except ValueError:
        logger.warning("Invalid %s='%s'; ignoring value", name, raw_value)

def _env_bool(name: str, default: bool) -> bool:

def _build_openrouter_settings() -> dict:
    """Collect generation parameters supported by OpenRouter's OpenAI-compatible API."""
    settings: dict = {}

    temperature = _env_optional_float("OPENROUTER_TEMPERATURE")
    if temperature is not None:
        settings["temperature"] = temperature

    top_p = _env_optional_float("OPENROUTER_TOP_P")
    if top_p is not None:

    frequency_penalty = _env_optional_float("OPENROUTER_FREQUENCY_PENALTY")
    if frequency_penalty is not None:

    reasoning_effort = (os.getenv("OPENROUTER_REASONING_EFFORT") or "").strip()

def _resolve_system_prompt() -> str:
    system_prompt_file = (os.getenv("OPENROUTER_SYSTEM_PROMPT_FILE") or "").strip()
    inline_prompt = (os.getenv("OPENROUTER_SYSTEM_PROMPT") or "").strip()

    if system_prompt_file:
        prompt_path = Path(system_prompt_file).expanduser()
        if not prompt_path.is_absolute():
            prompt_path = (ENV_PATH.parent / prompt_path).resolve()

        try:
            prompt_from_file = prompt_path.read_text(encoding="utf-8").strip()
        except OSError as exc:
            logger.warning(
                "Unable to load OPENROUTER_SYSTEM_PROMPT_FILE='{}': {}",
                prompt_path,
                exc,
            )
            return inline_prompt

        if not prompt_from_file:
            logger.warning(
                "OPENROUTER_SYSTEM_PROMPT_FILE='{}' is empty; falling back to OPENROUTER_SYSTEM_PROMPT",
                prompt_path,
            )
            return inline_prompt

        if inline_prompt:
            logger.warning(
                "Both OPENROUTER_SYSTEM_PROMPT_FILE and OPENROUTER_SYSTEM_PROMPT are set; using file prompt"
            )

        logger.info("Loaded system prompt from file: {}", prompt_path)
        return prompt_from_file

    return inline_prompt

    openrouter_settings = _build_openrouter_settings()
    logger.info("OpenRouter generation settings: {}", openrouter_settings)

    user_turn_count = 0
    _last_counted_msg_index: int = -1
    _conversation_started = False
    vad_stop_secs = _env_float("VAD_STOP_SECS", 0.8)
    user_turn_stop_timeout = _env_float("USER_TURN_STOP_TIMEOUT", 10.0)
    user_speech_timeout = _env_float("USER_SPEECH_TIMEOUT", 4.5)

    meralion_api_key = os.environ["MERALION_API_KEY"]
    meralion_base_url = os.getenv("MERALION_API_BASE_URL", "https://api.meralion.ai")
    meralion_translation_model = os.getenv(
        "MERALION_TRANSLATION_MODEL", "MERaLiON/MERaLiON-3-3B-ASR-CTM"
    )
    logger.info(
        "Using MERaLiON speech translation model: {} @ {}",
        meralion_translation_model,
        meralion_base_url,
    )
    stt = MERaLiONSpeechTranslationService(
        api_key=meralion_api_key,
        base_url=meralion_base_url,
        model=meralion_translation_model,
    )

    # --- MERaLiON-3-10B Hokkien renderer -----------------------------------------
    # Narrow transformation only (STREAMLINED_PIPELINE_CONTEXT.md section 3.5):
    # verified grounded English answer -> Singapore Hokkien Hanji. Runs on the
    # complete buffered LLM response (see processors/hokkien_renderer.py) so no
    # partial English fragments ever reach the renderer or the TTS model.
    enable_hokkien_renderer = _env_bool("ENABLE_HOKKIEN_RENDERER", True)
    hokkien_renderer: HokkienRenderer | None = None
    hokkien_render_client: MERaLiONHokkienRenderClient | None = None
    if enable_hokkien_renderer:
        render_prompt_file = os.getenv(
            "MERALION_RENDER_PROMPT_FILE", "prompt/english_to_hokkien-chinese.md"
        )

            "Using MERaLiON Hokkien renderer model: {} @ {} (prompt={})",
            render_model,
            meralion_base_url,
            render_prompt_file,

            api_key=meralion_api_key,
            prompt_template=_load_render_prompt_template(render_prompt_file),
            base_url=meralion_base_url,

        )

    else:
